prompt:

Return a single JSON object with EXACTLY these fields:
- ncId (string): unique identifier for the nonconformity
- source (string): source of the feedback or nonconformity
- description (string): detailed description of the item
- severity (string): severity level of the scenario
- category (string): classification category
- affectedQuantity (string): quantity of affected items
- customer (string): customer name or identifier
- containmentAction (string): immediate containment action taken
- priority (string): priority level for addressing this item
- assignedTo (string): person or team assigned to handle this
- status (string): current status of the item

End your response with exactly one line: ANSWER: <your JSON object>
